subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan (FinServCorp)
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@finservcorp.com>, Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 28 Oct 2026 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Demo recap + proposed POC plan (FinServCorp)

Hi Alex / Sarah,

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our demo and a proposed POC/evaluation plan attached. High-level notes: 

- What we showed: Redwood hosted API (low-friction), a dedicated inference option for predictable throughput, and the console for latency/cost monitoring. Vivek walked through integration flow and demo prompts.
- Business problem: You want to reduce latency for customer-facing summaries while keeping token cost within current budget and ensuring auditability for regulated data.
- Tentative success criteria (please confirm):
  1) 95th percentile response time < 600ms for 512 token avg prompt in our staging environment;
  2) Output quality score >= 0.85 on your internal rubric (we can help run evals);
  3) No PII leakage and passing your security checklist (SOC2 evidence + audit log access).

Attached: POC_Eval_Plan_v1.pdf (outline, milestones, responsibilities). Recording: redwood-demo-recording.mp4 (link below).

Proposed next steps & timeline (suggested):
- Week 0 (kickoff): finalize scope, access, and NDA/POC SOW (1 week)
- Week 1: Integration (sample dataset ingest + endpoint connectivity) — owner: Vivek
- Week 2: Run eval suite + quality tuning (jointly) — owner: FinServ (Alex) + Redwood (Marissa/Vivek)
- Week 3: Performance tuning & SLA validation (throughput, 95p latency) — owner: Redwood infra team
- Week 4: Wrap, metrics signoff, and go/no-go decision

Can you confirm that the success criteria above capture your priorities, and share who on your side will own test data and access? Also please confirm a 30-45 minute kickoff next week; here are a few slots we have:
- Tue 11/2 10:00-10:45 PT
- Wed 11/3 13:00-13:45 PT
- Thu 11/4 09:00-09:45 PT

Links: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1A2bPOC-FinServCorp (POC folder)

Thanks, looking forward to pairing on this.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0112

Attachment: POC_Eval_Plan_v1.pdf
Attachment: redwood-demo-recording.mp4 (drive link)

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@finservcorp.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Sarah Liu <sarah.liu@finservcorp.com>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan (FinServCorp)

Thanks Marissa, solid recap and appreciated the clear plan. A few clarifying items from our side before we lock the kickoff: 

1) Success metric: the quality score threshold (0.85) sounds reasonable but can you share the eval rubric you use (precision/recall or human-rated)? We need to align on exact labeling guidelines.
2) Data/access: we'll own and provide the test dataset. We'll need instructions for a staging S3 bucket and any required IAM role.
3) Security: please send the SOC2 snippet and the list of logs/fields available in audit logs. We will run these through our security team.
4) Timeline: our preferred kickoff is Wed 11/3 13:00 PT. Can Vivek join the meeting to confirm integration steps?

Also, two asks: 1) can you share a short SOW/one-pager we can use for internal sign-off and 2) do you have any estimate on expected token cost for the sample workload (we'll share sample sizes in the kickoff)?

If you can send the SOW and the eval rubric today, I'll get internal approvals started.

— Alex
Alex Jenkins | Head of ML Platforms, FinServCorp
alex.jenkins@finservcorp.com | (212) 555-0199

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@finservcorp.com>
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 29 Oct 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Demo recap + proposed POC plan (FinServCorp)

Alex, great questions, thanks. Quick responses and actions below.

- Eval rubric: attached to the POC folder (we've added an "Eval Rubric v1.docx"). It includes the scoring details (human-rated 1-5 with mapping to 0-1 score, plus token-level precision examples). We'll also run an automated suite and provide a human-review sample.
- Staging access: Vivek will send the exact IAM policy and S3 instructions prior to kickoff. Vivek, can you post the integration checklist in the shared folder?
- SOC2 + logs: link in the folder titled "Security_Evidence_SOC2.pdf" (redacted) — Laura, can you confirm if that's sufficient to start the security review?
- SOW/one-pager: attaching a short SOW stub and a POC acceptance checklist (see POC_Eval_Plan_v1.pdf). Marissa attaching a one-page SOW for internal sign-off.
- Token cost estimate: ballpark for the sample workload (average prompt 450 tokens, expected traffic 200 req/day) — estimated ~ $220/week on hosted API (before batching/optimizations). We'll refine after we see the sample dataset.

Confirmed kickoff Wed 11/3 13:00 PT — Vivek and Laura will join. Action owners: 
- Vivek: integration checklist + IAM + join kickoff (owner for infra/integration)
- Laura: security evidence + onboarding checklist + CS ownership for the trial
- Marissa: SOW + HubSpot deal updates + schedule

Alex, can you confirm who on your side will take the operational owner for the evaluation (dataset ingestion, labeling point-of-contact)? Also, please confirm if legal needs a draft SOW earlier than kickoff.

Thanks,
Marissa

Attachments: POC_Eval_Plan_v1.pdf, SOW_OnePager_v1.docx

Confirmed, Wed 11/3 13:00 PT works for our team. I'll own the dataset handoff (I'll share sample data drop instructions and a CSV of expected labels by EOD Mon). Looking forward to the kickoff.

— Sarah

- Laura: confirm whether Security_Evidence_SOC2.pdf is enough for their security team; if not, list additional artifacts and timeline.
